packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: auto-merge minor + patch after passing CI
Helm charts: separate dashboard entries per chart (high-touch)
Kubernetes base images / sidecar images: 7-day soak

Base/sidecar image DIGEST refreshes (same tag, rebuilt image = the CVE-patch stream): auto-merge after the 7-day soak + passing CI, WITHOUT dashboard approval. This is the H-4.7 cadence fix — pure digest bumps were piling up unmerged behind the manual approval above, leaving running images stale despite pinDigests. Version (major/minor/patch) bumps still require dashboard approval via the rule above; this only relaxes same-tag digest refreshes. Consistent with the existing github-actions digest auto-merge. Merge is repo-only — the cluster is rolled separately (see docs/03-runbooks/base-image-cve-cadence.md). To revert to fully-manual, set automerge:false.

Keycloak base image — operator review before merge. Both version and digest updates surface on the dependency dashboard and merge only on operator approval; merging runs the keycloak-image-build pipeline, then the CR digest is cut over by hand (operator-backlog #48).
SecLists HIBP password blacklist: yearly cadence is fine
node_modules in any TS project — security PRs immediately, others batched weekly
k3s + Kubernetes version: never auto-bump; gated by maintenance window

jwx: major (v3/v4) updates disabled — security-critical JWT/DPoP code in apps/lib/api-auth; the migration is parked + tracked in operator-backlog #44 (revisit ~2026-07-21). v2 minor/patch updates still flow normally. To resume, set enabled to true (or delete this rule).
Wazuh SIEM images: coordinated multi-image upgrade — own dashboard entry, not folded into the non-major sweep. See operator-backlog #45.

customManagers.description: Keycloak version + base-image digest in the custom Dockerfile. matchStringsStrategy 'combination' builds one dependency from the KEYCLOAK_VERSION (currentValue) and KEYCLOAK_BASE_DIGEST (currentDigest) ARGs, so Renovate can apply both version and digest updates rather than only the digest.
SecLists HIBP blacklist commit pin in Keycloak Dockerfile
CHART_VER pins in platform/components/*.sh helm install scripts

MinIO chart version pin in 07a-minio.sh — the generic CHART_VER customManager above can't infer the chart's actual repo URL (https://charts.min.io) from the surrounding script context, so it falls through to the deprecated google bucket and silently never matches. This pins MinIO explicitly. (Operator-backlog #55 / #56 — without this, MinIO has gone 17 months stale unnoticed.)
